newsitem.title: USA: Nview Corp sees Q2 loss on drop in sales.
newsitem.headline: Nview Corp sees Q2 loss on drop in sales.

text.p: Nview Corp said on Wednesday sales for the second quarter of 1997 will be roughly 25 percent lower than sales in the first quarter of the year, and expects to report a loss for the quarter.

The projection display products company said sales in both Europe and the Pacific Rim were lower than expected, and sales fell significantly to its primary original equipment manufacturer (OEM) customer, Polaroid Corp.

"The company's products have faced a continued increase in competition and, as a result, the company has revised its target markets, withdrawing from the computer distribution channel and concentrating on developing relationships in specialized vertical markets," Nview said in a statement.
It added that complete financial results for the second quarter will be released on or about July 17.
The company traded at 1-5/8, down 5/16, at midday.
